evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.limitation: The scenario definition for 'syndra_derived_order_39' is not present under data/ (data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json holds only 22 named CP/E9 scenarios, none of them Syndra). The fight mode, level, ranks and haste of scenario 39 were therefore NOT available. The determination below is of which ability is correct in the final slot of the opening rotation, which is decidable from the ability data alone because every ability is off cooldown at t=0.

step_0_what_cast_order_is.claim: cast_order is the time-ordered shared-timeline cast schedule; for the opening rotation it is a permutation of the champion's ability slots.
step_0_what_cast_order_is.source_quote: Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (_schedule_shared_casts). ... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.
step_0_what_cast_order_is.corroboration: data/champion-audit/batch-p1-3.json records a 4-element permutation for a comparable champion: 'Q 176/W 330/R 385 with cast_order R,Q,W,E'.
step_0_what_cast_order_is.consequence: All four abilities are off cooldown at t=0, so the first four entries of cast_order are the four abilities in combo-priority order, each exactly once. Index 3 (0-based) is therefore the LAST ability of the opening rotation.

step_1_W_at_index_3_cannot_be_a_recast.reasoning: The only other way W could occupy index 3 is a W recast. That is ruled out by cooldown gating.
step_1_W_at_index_3_cannot_be_a_recast.formula_quoted: cd' = cd * 100/(100 + AH)   (docs/math-foundations.md 5, 'Ability haste (effective_cooldown)', verdict EXACT; also CLAUDE.md domain knowledge)
step_1_W_at_index_3_cannot_be_a_recast.arithmetic: Three prior casts occupy at most ~0.75 s (docs/math-foundations.md 5 burn row: 'One-rotation cast spread uses a 0.5 s GCD estimate'; Syndra's sourced cast times are Q 'none', W 'none', E 0.25, R 0.25). Requiring 8 * 100/(100+AH) <= 0.75 gives AH >= 967 ability haste at W rank 5, and AH >= 1500 at rank 1. No reachable build approaches that.
step_1_W_at_index_3_cannot_be_a_recast.conclusion: W at index 3 is not a recast; it can only mean W was ranked LAST in the combo priority, i.e. R was cast at index <= 2.

step_2_R_is_the_only_order_dependent_dam.R_wiki_text: Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.
step_2_R_is_the_only_order_dependent_dam.arithmetic_check: 240 = 3 x 80 and 560 = 7 x 80 (likewise 360/840 at rank 2 and 480/1120 at rank 3). The wiki's own min/max rows confirm the sphere count is 3 (self-conjured only) to 7 (3 + 4 grabbed live spheres). R's damage therefore ranges over a factor of 7/3 = 2.33x purely as a function of how many Dark Spheres are already alive when R is cast.

sphere_producers.Q: Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location ... The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.
sphere_producers.W: Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere ... If a Dark Sphere is grabbed, its duration is refreshed
sphere_producers.E: Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from Syndra (displaces spheres away from Syndra; creates none)

step_2_R_is_the_only_order_dependent_dam.order_dependence_of_the_other_slots: Q (90/125/160/195/230 +70% AP), W (70/100/130/160/190 +65% AP, plus the 60-splinter true-damage row) and E (60/95/130/165/200 +60% AP) have no leveling row whose value depends on how many spheres are alive; their sphere interactions are stun/knockback/slow, which data/champion-audit/batch-6.json lists as out of scope ('E/W CC (stun, knockback, slow - utility only)'). R is the sole slot with an order-dependent damage term.
step_2_R_is_the_only_order_dependent_dam.conclusion: The damage-maximizing opening rotation casts R after every sphere-generating/refreshing cast, i.e. R LAST among {Q, W, E, R}. Placing R at index <= 2 (which is what old[3] = W entails) throws away up to 4 x (80/120/160 + 20% AP) of sourced damage.

step_3_fallback_order_agrees.spec_quote: src/calculator/damage.py computes a rotation from a DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER (fixed Q,W,E,R) ... with a documented fallback (default Q,W,E,R order) for champions with no combo signal.
step_3_fallback_order_agrees.source: data/worklists/f2-task.md (rotation-resolver work item; read as specification, not as the change under test)
step_3_fallback_order_agrees.note: Syndra is not among the F2 combo batch (Cassiopeia, Varus, Brand, Vladimir, Aatrox, Jhin, Annie, Lux, Zed, Aphelios), and her R sphere count is carried as a module option ('R sphere count (r_spheres)', data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json), not as a rotation coupling. Under the documented fallback her order is Q, W, E, R, whose index 3 is R.
step_3_fallback_order_agrees.conclusion: Fallback ordering and the wiki-derived damage argument agree: index 3 = R.

step_4_R_single_cast_consistency.quote: R casts exactly once per timed fight (model constraint, documented) / 'R single-cast'
step_4_R_single_cast_consistency.consequence: R appears exactly once in cast_order, so 'R at index 3' is consistent with R not appearing anywhere else; a schedule that both casts R early and leaves W at index 3 would still be the strictly worse rotation by step 2.
step_4_R_single_cast_consistency.cooldown_data: R cooldown 120/100/80 s, affectedByCdr true (data/champions.json) - no recast is possible inside any corpus fight window regardless.

independent_computation.mana_is_not_a_gate: Syndra base mana 480 (+40/level, data/champions.json stats.mana). Full rotation cost at max ranks = Q 60 + W 100 + E 50 + R 100 = 310 < 480, so mana never forces R later in the order.

residual_uncertainty: The scenario's own configuration (fight mode, level, ranks, ability haste, splinter option) is not reachable from data/, so the full expected cast_order list could not be reconstructed; only the identity of the ability correct at the final opening-rotation slot was computed. That computation does not depend on any of the missing parameters: every ability is off cooldown at t=0, W cannot recast that early at any reachable ability haste, and R is the only slot whose sourced damage depends on where it sits in the order.
